brief:
Extend the existing Mini F1 assembly with 14 new exterior parts. Reuse MON-001, FWG-001, FLR-001 and RWG-001 exactly as registered (latest versions): do not redesign, move or change them.

GENERAL RULES
- Concept level, project vehicle coordinates (+X front, +Y left, +Z up, mm, origin on the front-axle centreline, Z=0 ground plane). Left parts on +Y, right parts on -Y. Right parts are derived from the left ones: left/right pairs are exact mirror images of each other, except the wheels (the right wheel is the left wheel turned 180 degrees about the vertical axis). Design only the left part of each pair and list the right part as mirror_of the left.
- Each part is ONE connected solid, built in its own local frame and positioned only by its pose. For wheels the local origin is the wheel centre and the axle is the local Y axis.
- All dimensions below are my concept assumptions, not regulation values. Use only the FIA excerpts the system supplies; mark everything else as an assumption. No FIA compliance claims.
- Planned contacts are listed per part. Everything else must keep at least 20 mm clear. Report every planned contact and every unintended overlap.
- Colours: tyres near-black, rims silver, suspension dark grey, sidepods and engine cover the same red as the monocoque, halo dark grey, mirrors black.

REGISTERED PARTS (approximate facts, check against the records)
- MON-001: X -3700..550, |Y|<=450, Z 30..740, flat bottom Z=30. Half-width about 450 at X=-3700, 436 at -2600, 382 at -1400, 247 at -400, 175 at X=0, 75 at the nose tip. Top surface Z about 730 at X=-3700, 690 at -2600, 620 at -1400, 366 at -400. Cockpit opening X -2300..-1500, |Y|<=250; rim ring X -2360..-1440, |Y|<=310, rim top plane Z=740.
- FWG-001: X 550..1150, |Y|<=850, Z 50..330.
- FLR-001: X -4300..-400, top Z=30, bottom Z=0; |Y|<=800 up to X=-2400, tapering to 520 at X=-3030, 520 to the rear end; diffuser ramp over the last 600 mm.
- RWG-001: X -4450..-3700, |Y|<=520, Z 400..1100.

NEW PARTS
A) Wheels WHL-FL, WHL-FR, WHL-RL, WHL-RR: cylinder along Y with rounded tyre shoulders, a recessed rim face on the outboard side and a hub boss (radius 90, length 60) on the inboard side.
 - Front: centre X=0, Z=360, |Y|=800, diameter 720, width 300 (tyre inner face |Y|=650, outer 950); hub boss from |Y|=650 to 590.
 - Rear: centre X=-3400, Z=370, |Y|=760, diameter 740, width 380 (inner face 570, outer 950); hub boss from 570 to 510.
 - A wheel touches nothing except its own suspension.
B) Suspension SUF-L, SUF-R, SUR-L, SUR-R: one connected solid per side and axle: an upper and a lower wishbone as 30 mm square beams forming a triangle in plan view, plus a pushrod to the hub.
 - Outboard ends: flat faces lying exactly in the hub-boss end plane (|Y|=590 front, 510 rear), inside the 90 mm hub radius around the wheel centre: planned contact (touching) with the wheel.
 - Inboard ends: planned shallow embedding, at most 20 mm deep, into the monocoque side wall. Front pickups X -300..+100, Z 100..200. Rear pickups X -3550..-3250, Z 150..500.
C) Sidepods SDP-L, SDP-R: lofted body from X=-700 (front) to X=-2950 (rear), bottom face on the floor top (Z=30): planned contact (touching) with FLR-001. Inner wall follows the monocoque side about 10 mm inside it: |Y| 280 at X=-700, 372 at -1400, 426 at -2600, 431 at -2950 (planned embedding into MON-001, at most 25 mm). Outer wall: |Y| 700 at X=-1200 narrowing to 540 at X=-2950. Top: Z 400 at X=-700, 420 at -1800, 300 at -2950, rounded top edges. A shallow inlet pocket (about 200 x 150 mm, 120 mm deep) in the front face. Relieve the outer lower edge (undercut) only as far as the geometry stays robust.
D) Engine cover ENG-001: airbox and shark-fin spine on the monocoque top. Airbox X -2700..-2450, |Y|<=140, up to Z 1000 with a front intake opening. Spine behind it, |Y|<=40, tapering down to Z 800 at X=-3600. Base plane Z=680 embedded into the monocoque top (planned embedding, at most 60 mm). Stays clear of the rear wing.
E) Halo HAL-001: U-shaped hoop: two side bars (40 mm thick) from rear feet at X about -2330, |Y| 280, rising to a top at Z about 900, and a central front pillar with its foot at X about -1470, Y=0. Foot bottoms lie exactly on the rim top plane Z=740, inside the rim ring: planned contact (touching) with MON-001.
F) Mirrors MIR-L, MIR-R: short stalk plus a rectangular housing (about 40 x 160 x 80 mm). Stalk base embedded at most 15 mm into the monocoque side at X about -1700, Z about 540; housing at |Y| about 560. Must not touch the halo or sidepods.

OUTPUT
Report component status, measured bounding boxes, every planned contact result, unintended overlaps, FIA statuses, assumptions and failures. Generate iso, front and top screenshots.

parts.name: Monocoque
parts.role: survival cell / chassis tub with nose and cockpit opening
parts.notes: Tapered loft from wide rear section (X=-3700, 900 wide x 700 high, Z 30-730) to narrow nose tip (X=+550, 200 wide x 200 high, Z 30-230, flat vertical tip face that the front wing mount touches). Flat bottom at Z=30 sits on floor top face. Open cockpit cut from top, approx X -2300 to -1500, 500 wide, with raised rim 60 mm high around opening. Flat vertical rear face at X=-3700 for rear wing supports. Half-width 450 is well inside the 950 mm limit.

parts.name: Front wing
parts.role: front wing: main plane, flap(s), endplates; ahead of the front axle
parts.notes: Main plane (chord 350, 30 thick) spanning 1800 at low Z (~70-100) at front X 800-1150; two flaps chord 180 stacked rearward/upward with small slot gaps, giving up to three sections per Y-plane. Two vertical endplates (20 thick, 280 high, Z 50-330) at Y=±880..±900. Central mount/pylon block Y ±60, from flap/main plane rearward to X=550, Z 100-230, its rear face touching the monocoque nose tip face (no overlap).

parts.name: Floor
parts.role: floor plate under the car with rear diffuser ramp
parts.notes: Thin flat plate X -4300 to -400, Y ±800, Z 0-30; top face Z=30 carries the monocoque. Simplified side edges: chamfered/tapered outer edges and slightly tapered front corners in plan. Rear diffuser ramp: wedge X -3700 to -4300, Y ±500, rising from Z=30 at X=-3700 to Z=230 at rear edge, behind the monocoque rear face so no intersection. Single solid body.

parts.name: Rear wing
parts.role: rear wing: main plane, flap, endplates, central support
parts.notes: Main plane chord 350 at Z ~870-905, X -4400 to -4050, span 1000 between endplates; one flap chord 200 above/behind with slot gap (Z ~930-1000). Two endplates 20 thick, Z 700-1100, X -4450 to -3950 at Y ±500..±520. Two simplified support plates (20 thick in Y, centred Y=±100) from front face at X=-3700 (touching monocoque rear face, Z 400-730 region) sweeping rearward up to the main plane underside. Clear of floor diffuser (max Z 230).

parts.name: Wheel front left
parts.role: front-left wheel and tyre on the front axle (X=0), +Y side
parts.notes: Axle along the part-local Y axis through the local origin (wheel centre), rotationally symmetric about it. Tyre cylinder radius 360 from local Y -150 to +150 with 40 mm rounded shoulders, near-black. Recessed silver rim face (dia 460, 30 deep) on the outboard (+Y) face. Hub boss on the inboard (-Y) side: radius 90 from local Y -150 to -210; its end face at Y -210 is the suspension contact plane. One connected solid.

Hub boss on the inboard (-Y) side: radius 90 from local Y -190 to -250; end face at Y -250 is the suspension contact plane. One connected solid.

parts.notes: One connected dark-grey solid, 30 mm square beams. Lower wishbone: inboard nodes (80,145,120) and (-280,210,120), outboard node (0,590,300). parts.role: right sidepod bodywork with radiator inlet, beside the monocoque
parts.notes: Red lofted solid, local X 0 (front) to -2250 (rear), bottom flat at local Z 0 on the floor top. Inner wall Y: 280 at X0, 372 at -700, 426 at -1900, 431 at -2250 (embeds <=25 into monocoque). Outer wall Y: ~620 at X0, 700 at -500, 540 at -2250. Top Z: 370 at X0, 390 at -1100, 270 at -2250, top edges filleted ~60. Front-face inlet pocket ~200(Y) x 150(Z), 120 deep, centred Y~460, Z~220. Modest outer lower undercut (~60 mm) only if robust.

parts.name: Mirror right
parts.role: right rear-view mirror housing on its stalk beside the cockpit
parts.notes: Black single solid. Stalk 30x30 along +Y from local Y 385 (embedded ~10, max 15, into monocoque side wall at |Y|~395) to Y 480, centred X 0, Z 0. Housing box 40 (X) x 160 (Y) x 80 (Z) centred at (0,560,0), small edge fillets. Keep >=20 mm from halo and sidepod.

assumptions.text: Reused parts keep their registered pose at the VCS origin and registered envelopes (MON-001 Z max 790 per registry).
Monocoque side-wall half-width is linearly interpolated between the brief's stations to set inboard embed depths.
Wheel rim face diameters 460 (front) / 480 (rear), 30 mm recess, 40 mm tyre shoulder radius.
Front pickups: lower Z 120, upper Z 185 at X +80 and -280; outboard nodes at Z 300/420.
Rear pickups: lower Z 180, upper Z 470 at X -3270/-3530; outboard nodes at Z 310/430.
Sidepod outer half-width about 620 at the front face, inlet pocket centred Y~460, Z~250 in VCS, undercut ~60 mm.
Halo top bar centreline at Z 900 (outer surface 920); front pillar 40 mm wide.
Mirror stalk 30x30 mm, housing centre Y 560, Z 540; engine intake opening about 160x120 mm.
